description: Ask a plain-language question about a car and its safety recalls ("does the 2019 Toyota RAV4 have an airbag recall?", "is it safe to drive a 2015 Ford Mustang?"). The make, model, year and subject are read out of the question and the answer is built from the record by fixed rules: sentences with counts, the matching American recall campaigns with do-not-drive and park-outside warnings, and links. No language model writes the answer.

question.description: The question, in plain words. Name the make, model and model year when known.

name: ask_record
